thread:
laura: noticed a discrepancy between invoice_preview and final ledger for tenant 'sunrise' during the routing-refactor canary. Preview shows extra tokens.

ezra: which extra tokens? any particular route?

laura: Preview spikes on card 'per-tenant tokens' for 10:10-10:12. Ledger stable. Sample preview event below: 
```
{"req_id":"r-2001","tenant":"sunrise","tokens":2048,"resolved_route":"r-llama-7","route_candidates":["r-llama-7","r-fallback"],"meta_debug":true}
```

priya: I think preview pipeline is expanding route_candidates into multiple attribution rows (for debugging) and then aggregator sums them. Ledger only uses resolved_route.

ben: That was an intentional change to surface candidates during rollout. But we didn't wire aggregator to collapse before summing. Oops.

laura: short-term: we should change aggregator to group by req_id and use resolved_route. Long-term: emit candidates as metadata not separate events.

ezra: agreed. I'll push a 1-line change to aggregator to dedupe by req_id and prefer resolved_route. Will canary it.

priya: also add metric preview.dup_attrib_rate and alert when > 0.5% over 5m.

infra-bot: deploy: preview-aggregator v3.7 -> v3.8 triggered by ezra at 6771240010

ben: we need a backfill to reconcile the preview history for affected window so console matches ledger for customers. Laura can you run a small backfill job?

laura: I'll run a backfill that collapses dup events and emits corrected preview rows. Will post diff.

ezra: if canary looks good, promote. If not, we'll revert resolver change.

priya: also update console changelog to note that preview semantics changed during the rollout and planned reconciliation. Support should get a short blurb.

laura: yup. Assigning: @ezra deploy fix; @priya metric+changelog; @ben backfill orchestration; I'll draft customer note.

ben: ack.

laura: thanks, closing loop here once backfill completes. :thumbsup:
